name: Strelkove-Dzhankoi Gas Pipeline
monitor_reason: length: no sourced length. The only figure is 54.7 km at 12 in from a GulfPub trace, which is a lead and cannot be cited. Sponsor and concrete step also weak, since this is an existing field line.
researcher_notes: Not an existing GEM row. The 47 existing Ukraine gas rows include nothing at Strelkove, Dzhankoi, Henichesk or Crimea. Two news articles from November 2016 (Ukrainska Pravda economic section and UNIAN) say gas from the Strelkove field on the Arabat Spit in Kherson Oblast went by a pipeline linking Strelkove to the Dzhankoi field in Crimea. The field was developed by Plast and Chornomornaftogaz, the second a Ukrainian state firm seized by Russia in 2014. The line was already running in 2016, so it predates the 2023 Crimea to Henichesk reverse line. It is probably a separate older field line, but no source gives its route, so overlap with the dzhankoi-genichesk corridor cannot be ruled out. A third candidate source, a Slovo i Dilo article, loaded but did not mention Strelkove, so it is not used. Both ends are inside Ukraine under GEM naming rules. No length, diameter, capacity or owner is stated in any source found. Both articles also trace to one 2016 report by Ukrainska Pravda, so the sources are not independent. Add as a Ukraine row only if a sourced length of 25 km or more appears.
